scripted_turns: $flow how a Roamstay guest changes their booking dates in the app, on a new board in our Roamstay Product plan. From the booking page they tap Change dates and pick new dates. If the room is not free on those dates they see other rooms. If the new price is higher they pay the difference, if it is lower they get the difference back as credit, and if it is the same nothing is charged. Then they see the updated booking. The help article also says: the date picker shows only nights the hotel has open, the other rooms list shows up to 3 rooms at the same hotel with their price for the new dates, a higher price is charged to the card on file, credit is kept for 12 months, and the updated booking is also sent by email.
